- insurance.catalog.catalog_schedule cold start under 900ms on mobile

#### slo
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket availability 99.9 monthly
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket p50 42ms p99 542ms
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket error budget 43m per month, burn alert at 2x
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket freshness lag under 5s for derived reads
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket backlog drain under 15m after incident
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket cold start under 900ms on mobile
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket dependency budget: at most 3 synchronous hops
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket paging policy: burn rate only, never raw error count
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket dashboards owned by insurance-notification
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket load tested at 3x forecast peak before release
- insurance.notification.notification_ticket degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes
#### security
- ctl0 insurance.notification.notification_ticket authz checked at handler not gateway
- ctl1 insurance.notification.notification_ticket tenant scope asserted in query
- ctl2 insurance.notification.notification_ticket secrets from KMS never env literal
- ctl3 insurance.notification.notification_ticket input length capped before parse
- ctl4 insurance.notification.notification_ticket output encoded per sink
- ctl5 insurance.notification.notification_ticket audit row written in same transaction
- ctl6 insurance.notification.notification_ticket PII column encrypted at rest
- ctl7 insurance.notification.notification_ticket replay window enforced

#### slo
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule availability 99.9 monthly
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule p50 40ms p99 600ms
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule error budget 43m per month, burn alert at 2x
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule freshness lag under 5s for derived reads
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule backlog drain under 15m after incident
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule cold start under 900ms on mobile
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule dependency budget: at most 3 synchronous hops
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule paging policy: burn rate only, never raw error count
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule dashboards owned by insurance-partner
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule load tested at 3x forecast peak before release
- insurance.partner.partner_schedule degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes

- insurance.admin.admin_template availability 99.9 monthly
- insurance.admin.admin_template p50 55ms p99 615ms
- insurance.admin.admin_template error budget 43m per month, burn alert at 2x
- insurance.admin.admin_template freshness lag under 5s for derived reads
- insurance.admin.admin_template backlog drain under 15m after incident
- insurance.admin.admin_template cold start under 900ms on mobile
- insurance.admin.admin_template data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m
- insurance.admin.admin_template dependency budget: at most 3 synchronous hops
- insurance.admin.admin_template paging policy: burn rate only, never raw error count
- insurance.admin.admin_template dashboards owned by insurance-admin
- insurance.admin.admin_template load tested at 3x forecast peak before release
- insurance.admin.admin_template degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes

- inv6 insurance.archive.archive_rule: guest performing approve while review must leave metadata consistent and audited
- inv7 insurance.archive.archive_rule: service performing archive while settled must leave version consistent and audited
- inv8 insurance.archive.archive_rule: owner performing create while suspended must leave created_at consistent and audited
- inv9 insurance.archive.archive_rule: admin performing read while expired must leave updated_at consistent and audited
- inv10 insurance.archive.archive_rule: operator performing update while closed must leave deleted_at consistent and audited
- inv11 insurance.archive.archive_rule: analyst performing delete while purged must leave created_by consistent and audited

#### slo
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile availability 99.9 monthly
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile p50 40ms p99 660ms
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile error budget 43m per month, burn alert at 2x
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile freshness lag under 5s for derived reads
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile backlog drain under 15m after incident
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile cold start under 900ms on mobile
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile dependency budget: at most 3 synchronous hops
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile paging policy: burn rate only, never raw error count
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile dashboards owned by insurance-sandbox
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile load tested at 3x forecast peak before release
- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_profile degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes

- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_request degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes

#### invariants
- inv0 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_transfer: service performing create while active must leave tenant_id consistent and audited
- inv1 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_transfer: owner performing read while held must leave status consistent and audited
- inv2 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_transfer: admin performing update while review must leave label consistent and audited
- inv3 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_transfer: operator performing delete while settled must leave amount_minor consistent and audited
- inv4 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_transfer: analyst performing list while suspended must leave currency consistent and audited
- inv5 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_transfer: auditor performing export while expired must leave metadata consistent and audited

- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_schedule data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m

- insurance.sandbox.sandbox_schedule degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes

#### invariants
- inv0 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: operator performing update while held must leave amount_minor consistent and audited
- inv1 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: analyst performing delete while review must leave currency consistent and audited
- inv2 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: auditor performing list while settled must leave metadata consistent and audited
- inv3 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: partner performing export while suspended must leave version consistent and audited
- inv4 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: support performing approve while expired must leave created_at consistent and audited
- inv5 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: member performing archive while closed must leave updated_at consistent and audited
- inv6 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: guest performing create while purged must leave deleted_at consistent and audited
- inv7 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: service performing read while draft must leave created_by consistent and audited
- inv8 insurance.sandbox.sandbox_snapshot: owner performing update while pending must leave idempotency_key consistent and audited
